prompt: Describe a person who learns history and loves history
bullets: and explain how you feel about him/her

part2.question: Describe a person who learns history and loves history

segments.v: I want to talk about my father. He loves history very much. He is an engineer but he likes reading history books. He has many history books at home. He also watches history documentaries on TV every Sunday and he listens to history podcasts. He likes visiting historical places. Last year he took my family to Hoa Lư in Ninh Bình. He told us a lot about the history of that place. I think he loves history because it helps him understand the present. He also likes stories about people in the past. I admire my father because he knows a lot. Before, I didn't like history, but now I like it because of him. I hope I can be like him.
